source_detail: NBS monthly release, via akshare (EastMoney mirror)
notes: NBS publishes FAI as a year-to-date figure; value and yoy here are the source's single-month derivation and are noisy. ytd_yoy is left blank because NBS revises the prior-year base, so it cannot be reproduced from the cumulative levels. Jan-Feb combined per the usual NBS convention.
